blocks.prompt: 6 (a) A drug company has manufactured 7 million doses of a vaccine to date. They promise additional production at a rate of 1.4 million doses/month over the next year. How many doses of the vaccine, in total, will have been produced after a year?
blocks.explanation:
Company ke paas aaj tak 7 million doses ban chuki hain, aur har mahine barabar miqdaar (1.4 million) aur banti hai. Jab har qadam par ek hi miqdaar jude to kul ginti A.P. banati hai: shuru 7 se, common difference 1.4 (million mein).
Is hisse mein ek saal baad kul doses poochi gayi hain. Ek saal = 12 mahine.
Plan: 12 mahinon ki nayi doses nikal kar pehle wali 7 million mein jama karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: Abhi tak 7 million doses; agle 12 mahine har mahine 1.4 million aur.
Humein find karna hai: ek saal baad kul doses.
Tareeqa: \(n\) mahinon baad kul \(= 7 + 1.4n\) (million mein); ek saal ka matlab \(n = 12\).

Saal bhar ki production pehle wali doses mein jama karein
\[\text{Total} = 7 + 1.4 \times 12\]
\[= 7 + 16.8\]
\[= 23.8\]
Kyun: 12 mahine, har mahine 1.4 million: \(1.4 \times 12 = 16.8\) million nayi doses. Sawal "in total" poochta hai, is liye pehle se bani 7 million bhi jama karni hain.
Dhyan dein: sirf 16.8 likhna aam ghalti hai; "to date" wali 7 million na bhoolein.

blocks.prompt: 6 (b) A drug company has manufactured 7 million doses of a vaccine to date. They promise additional production at a rate of 1.4 million doses/month over the next year. The general term \(a_n\) describes the total number of doses of the vaccine produced. Describe the meaning of the variable \(n\) in the context of this problem. Find the general term \(a_n\)
blocks.explanation:
Company ke paas aaj tak 7 million doses ban chuki hain, aur har mahine barabar miqdaar (1.4 million) aur banti hai. Jab har qadam par ek hi miqdaar jude to kul ginti A.P. banati hai: shuru 7 se, common difference 1.4 (million mein).
Yahan do kaam hain: pehle batana hai ke \(n\) kya ginta hai, phir \(a_n\) ka formula likhna hai.
Total har mahine badalta hai, is liye \(n\) mahine ginta hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: Abhi tak 7 million doses; agle 12 mahine har mahine 1.4 million aur.
Humein find karna hai: \(n\) ka matlab aur \(a_n\) ka formula.
Tareeqa: A.P. jis ki shuru ki qeemat 7 aur common difference 1.4 hai.

Faisla karein ke \(n\) kya hai
\[n = \text{months from now}\]
Kyun: Production "per month" di gayi hai, is liye total mahine ke hisaab se badalta hai. To \(n\) aaj se guzre hue mahinon ki tadaad hai: aaj \(n = 0\), ek mahine baad \(n = 1\), waghera.

General term likhein
\[a_n = 7 + 1.4n\]
\[\text{(millions of doses)}\]
Kyun: 7 million se shuru kiya aur har mahine ke liye ek dafa 1.4 jora; \(n\) mahinon mein \(1.4n\). Tasdeeq: \(n = 12\) par \(7 + 16.8 = 23.8\), jo part (a) ka jawab hai.
blocks.final_answer: \(n\) = aaj se mahinon ki tadaad; \(a_n = 7 + 1.4n\) million doses

blocks.prompt: 6 (c) A drug company has manufactured 7 million doses of a vaccine to date. They promise additional production at a rate of 1.4 million doses/month over the next year. Find the value of \(a_{10}\) and interpret its meaning in words.
blocks.explanation:
Company ke paas aaj tak 7 million doses ban chuki hain, aur har mahine barabar miqdaar (1.4 million) aur banti hai. Jab har qadam par ek hi miqdaar jude to kul ginti A.P. banati hai: shuru 7 se, common difference 1.4 (million mein).
Part (b) ka formula \(a_n = 7 + 1.4n\) istemal karenge, \(n = 10\) rakhenge, aur phir lafzon mein batayenge ke is number ka matlab kya hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: Abhi tak 7 million doses; agle 12 mahine har mahine 1.4 million aur.
Humein find karna hai: \(a_{10}\) aur us ka matlab.
Tareeqa: Part (b) ka \(a_n = 7 + 1.4n\), \(n = 10\) ke saath.

Matlab batayein
Kyun: \(a_n\) kul doses (million mein) hai aur \(n\) mahine ginta hai. Is liye \(a_{10} = 21\) ka matlab: aaj se 10 mahine baad company kul 21 million doses bana chuki hogi.
Dhyan dein: "interpret" wale sawal mein sirf number likhna kaafi nahi; units aur waqt dono lafzon mein likhein.
